name: 3Cs (Company, Customers, Competitors)
summary: A quick strategic scan: what customers need, what competitors offer, and what the company can uniquely deliver. The strategy sits where the three overlap.
opening_line: I'd start with a quick scan of customers, competitors and our own company, looking for where customer needs, our strengths and competitors' gaps overlap.
when_to_use: Early scoping of a broad strategy question
A sub-bucket in market entry or new product cases
when_not_to_use: As a full structure for MBB cases: tailor it instead

buckets.name: Overlap
questions: Which customer need can we serve better than competitors?

common_mistakes: Too generic for the specific case
